stemMd: A laboratory allows a sample to be processed only if its label is legible. Sample R was processed. What must follow if the rule was obeyed?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Sample R was the only sample processed.

options.label: B
options.textMd: No unprocessed sample had a legible label.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Sample R had the highest priority.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Sample R had a legible label.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every legibly labelled sample was processed.

explanationMd: Only if makes legibility necessary for processing. Processing R therefore implies its label was legible. The converse, that all legible samples are processed, does not follow.

distractorRationale.e: The rule states a necessary, not sufficient, condition.
distractorRationale.b: An eligible sample might remain unprocessed for other reasons.
